{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Great Lakes Gas Transmission Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline.<ref name=source1>[http://bit.ly/2lohXsb Great Lakes Gas Transmission Pipeline,] Wikipedia, accessed September 2017</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from the Minnesota-Manitoba border at Emerson, MN to the Michigan-Ontario border at St. Clair, MI.

*'''Proposal year: '''1996<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gpo.gov/fdsys/pkg/FR-1996-05-20/html/96-12552.htm|title=gpo.gov|website=gpo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

=== System Wide Expansion (1998 Expansion Project) ===
The pipeline runs from Minnesota to Minnesota, Wisconsin.
*'''Owner: '''TC Energy Corp; TC PipeLines LP
*'''Length: '''71.5 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-1997-08-21/html/97-22205.htm|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''36 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-1997-08-21/html/97-22205.htm|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''1998<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Background==
The pipeline delivers natural gas from Western Canada to Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan, and eastern Canada. It operated by the Great Lakes Gas Transmission Company, which is owned by TC PipeLines (46.45%) and by subsidiaries of TC Energy (53.55%). TC Energy acquired its interest in the pipeline as part of a 2007 deal that included the acquisition of the ANR pipeline.<ref>[http://www.naturalgasintel.com/articles/16096-transcanada-completes-4-1b-acquisition-of-anr-pipe-great-lakes-gas-mi-storage TransCanada Completes $4.1B Acquisition of ANR Pipe, Great Lakes Gas, MI Storage], Natural Gas Intelligence, Feb. 26, 2007</ref>
